blocks.passage:
Cash flow is the movement of money in and out of a company. Money comes in when customers pay. Money goes out when bills arrive. A healthy company always has enough cash when the bills arrive.

In international business, cash flow is harder. Payments from abroad can be slow. A client in another country may take sixty or ninety days. In the meantime, you still have to pay suppliers and staff.

Many good companies fail not because they are unprofitable, but because they run out of cash.

items.q: What is cash flow?
options: The movement of money in and out of a company
items.why: "Cash flow is the movement of money in and out of a company."

items.q: When does money come in?
items.why: "Money comes in when customers pay."

items.q: Why is cash flow harder in international business?
options: Payments from abroad can be slow
items.why: "Payments from abroad can be slow. A client in another country may take sixty or ninety days."

items.q: What do you still have to do while waiting for a foreign payment?
items.why: "In the meantime, you still have to pay suppliers and staff."

items.q: Why do many good companies fail?
options: They run out of cash, even when profitable
items.why: "not because they are unprofitable, but because they run out of cash."

audio.text:
Your company is growing, last quarter was profitable, and yet you feel short of money all the time. That feels strange, but it's actually very common. Let me explain why.

Here's the trap. When you grow, you sell more. To sell more, you have to buy more materials and pay more staff — now, this month. But the money from those bigger sales comes in later, because your foreign clients pay in sixty or ninety days.

So growth actually pulls money out first and brings it back later. On paper you're doing great. In the bank account, it's tight.

This is why profitable companies can still get into trouble. Profit is what's left at the end. Cash flow is about timing — do you have the money when the bill lands?

The fix isn't to stop growing. It's to plan the timing: know when big payments come in, keep a small buffer of cash, and maybe ask your best clients to pay a little faster. Manage the timing, and growth becomes a joy instead of a worry.

items.q: How does the founder feel, even after a profitable quarter?
options: Short of money all the time
items.why: "you feel short of money all the time."

items.q: Why does growth pull money out first?
options: You buy more materials and pay more staff now, but sales money comes in later
items.why: "you have to buy more materials and pay more staff — now… the money… comes in later."

items.q: What is cash flow about?
options: Timing — having the money when the bill lands
items.why: "Cash flow is about timing — do you have the money when the bill lands?"

items.q: What is NOT the fix?
items.why: "The fix isn't to stop growing."

items.q: What does Sophie recommend?
options: Plan the timing, keep a buffer, and ask best clients to pay a little faster
items.why: "know when big payments come in, keep a small buffer of cash, and maybe ask your best clients to pay a little faster."

items.q: An **inflow** is…
items.why: Inflow = entrada de dinheiro.

items.q: An **outflow** is…
items.why: Outflow = saída de dinheiro.

items.q: Choose the correct phrase: "A company can **___** cash even when profitable."
items.why: Run out of = ficar sem.

items.q: "It's about **timing**." Timing means…
items.why: Timing = o momento em que as coisas acontecem.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "A company can be **___** but still short of cash."
items.why: Profitable = lucrativo.

items.q: "When you grow, cash gets **tight**." Tight here means…
items.why: Tight = apertado.

items.q: "Do you have the money when the bill **lands**?" To land here means to…
items.why: Land = chegar, vencer (a conta).

items.q: "Keep a small **buffer** of cash." A buffer is…
items.why: Buffer = reserva de segurança.

items.q: "Growth can **pull money out** first." To pull money out means to…
items.why: Pull money out = tirar caixa (antes de voltar).

items.q: "Manage the timing and growth becomes a **joy**, not a worry." This contrast means growth changes from…
items.why: De preocupação para alegria — a joy, not a worry.
